integrity: Original integral chain and primitive-basis argument checked from definitions; the independent published sphere-wedge theorem is used as a premise. Finite checks n=3 through 11 are corroboration, not an all-parameter proof. Residual literature-indexing and full-text-access risks are disclosed.
limitations: The result is restricted to ladders P_2 square P_n with n at least three. It does not establish an equivariant homotopy splitting, characterize homology of geometric quotients, or extend to wider grids. The rank uses a previously established homotopy theorem; the integral cycle basis and action are proved here.
title: Primitive square-pair cycles in three-robust ladder complexes
